rows.headline: IEX expects market coupling implementation to take two years
rows.hook: Market coupling delayed by two more years
rows.summary: Indian Energy Exchange (IEX) management stated that market coupling in the power sector is unlikely to be implemented for at least another two years. The government has yet to notify the necessary rules to facilitate this transition. Market coupling aims to aggregate buy and sell bids from all power exchanges to determine a single market clearing price. This delay maintains the current status quo for power trading dynamics in India.
rows.whats_next: Government notification of power market coupling rules
rows.why_it_matters: IEX maintains its dominant market share without immediate competitive price pressure.

rows.headline: Fewer IIT and IIM alumni are founding startups in 2026
rows.hook: Elite campus startup interest cools down
rows.summary: Data from Tracxn shows that 79 IIT alumni and 20 IIM alumni launched tech startups between January and August 2026, down from 307 and 71 respectively for the full year of 2025. Industry experts attribute this shift to top-tier graduates opting for safer corporate roles in AI rather than taking entrepreneurial risks. Meanwhile, overall tech startup formations have risen due to lower entry barriers from AI tools and recent layoffs. Indian retail investors tracking early-stage venture trends and startup ecosystem health should note this divergence between elite alumni participation and broader startup volumes.
rows.why_it_matters: Premium talent pool shifts from founding startups to corporate jobs.
